description: Hybrid Discovery, Ranking, and Digest Quality - improve digest relevance with full-text enrichment, dedupe, bounded discovery, and visible run-health reporting.

userStories.title: Add richer candidate and source config types
userStories.description: As a developer, I want typed candidate and source configuration models so the pipeline can support enrichment, discovery sources, and bounded run budgets safely.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a candidate type that includes snippet text, optional fullText, canonicalUrl, source metadata, and score metadata
Add source config support for monitored and discovery modes
Add digest-level candidate budget config for maxRawCandidatesPerRun, maxFullTextFetchesPerRun, and maxRankedCandidatesForClaude
Config loader applies sensible defaults for new optional source and budget fields
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Return richer candidates from existing fetchers
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the current feed, Reddit, and HN fetchers to emit richer candidate items so later stages can enrich, dedupe, and rank them consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: Feed, Reddit, and HN fetchers return the richer candidate type instead of the current minimal feed item shape
Returned candidates include sourceType, sourceMode, tier, snippet, and canonicalUrl placeholders or derived values
HN query terms are configurable from source config instead of only hardcoded in source code
Fetcher and orchestrator tests are updated for the richer candidate shape
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add bounded full-text enrichment step
userStories.description: As a digest reader, I want selected candidates enriched with article content so ranking and summaries use the substance of an item instead of only teaser text.
acceptanceCriteria: Add an enrichment module that fetches article HTML or source API content for selected candidates
All curated items are eligible for enrichment subject to maxFullTextFetchesPerRun
Community candidates are only enriched after a lightweight first-pass gate or bounded candidate cap
Enriched candidates record contentFetched, extractionMethod, and extractionError when applicable
When extraction fails, the pipeline keeps the candidate with snippet fallback instead of dropping it
Enrichment tests cover successful extraction, empty extraction, and network failure fallback
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add URL canonicalisation and duplicate clustering
userStories.description: As a digest reader, I want repeated stories merged across sources so the digest does not waste space on duplicate coverage.
acceptanceCriteria: Add URL canonicalisation before ranking
Exact duplicate stories across sources are collapsed into a single cluster
Near-duplicate title matching is mildly aggressive and can group materially similar titles for the same story
Duplicate clusters preserve alternate source links for later summary or debugging use
Tests cover canonical URL handling, exact duplicates, and near-duplicate title clustering
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add bounded ranking step with structured scores
userStories.description: As a digest reader, I want candidates ranked before summarisation so the digest surfaces the highest-value unique stories first.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a ranking module that assigns relevance, signal, novelty, fit, final, bucket, and reason for each ranked candidate
Ranking combines deterministic priors such as freshness or source trust with Claude-generated scoring
Only a bounded number of deduped candidates are sent to Claude for ranking based on maxRankedCandidatesForClaude
Summarisation input is the top-ranked unique stories rather than an unordered set of filtered items
Ranking tests verify structured score parsing for valid responses
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Validate Claude ranking and summary responses strictly
userStories.description: As an operator, I want malformed Claude output rejected clearly so the digest cannot silently lose or mis-rank items.
acceptanceCriteria: Ranking responses reject invalid JSON, duplicate indexes, missing indexes, invalid bucket values, and out-of-range scores
Summary responses reject malformed JSON and invalid structured fields instead of silently accepting bad output
Every candidate sent to Claude is accounted for exactly once when the response contract requires it
Validation failures produce a clear error or explicit degraded-run path rather than silent omission
Tests cover invalid JSON, duplicate indexes, missing candidates, and invalid score values
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add run report and visible run-health grading
userStories.description: As a digest reader, I want visible run-health metrics in the digest so I can tell when a run is incomplete without checking logs.
acceptanceCriteria: Each run writes a machine-readable report with source-level counts and overall totals
Run health is calculated from source-health percentage only in the initial implementation
Run health uses grades A for >90%, B for >80%, C for >70%, D for >60%, E for >50%, and F for <=50%
Grade A is treated as not degraded and lower grades are reported as progressively worse run health
Digest frontmatter includes source-health percentage and run-health letter grade
Tests cover grade mapping, degraded-run thresholds, and run report generation
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add bounded YouTube discovery source
userStories.description: As a digest reader, I want recent relevant YouTube results included through a bounded discovery source so useful video content can reach the digest without unbounded search.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a YouTube discovery source type with lookbackHours, query list or trusted channels, and maxResultsPerQuery
The pipeline refuses to run YouTube discovery without explicit bounds
YouTube candidates enter the same enrichment, dedupe, and ranking pipeline as monitored-source candidates
Config and adapter tests cover source parsing and enforcement of YouTube query or result caps
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add bounded GitHub releases discovery source
userStories.description: As a digest reader, I want recent GitHub releases from tracked orgs or repos included so tooling updates surface quickly without broad GitHub searching.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a GitHub discovery source type limited to releases only in the initial implementation
GitHub discovery requires explicit repo or organisation configuration, a bounded time window, and a per-run result cap
GitHub release candidates enter the same enrichment, dedupe, and ranking pipeline as other candidates
Config and adapter tests cover source parsing and enforcement of GitHub result caps
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Wire the new staged pipeline through index and summary generation
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the CLI orchestration updated to use the new staged pipeline so all digests run with enrichment, dedupe, ranking, and reporting in the correct order.
acceptanceCriteria: Index orchestration runs the stages in order: fetch lightweight candidates, enrich selected candidates, dedupe, rank, summarise, write digest, write run report
Digest rendering and summary prompts use fullText when present and fall back to snippet text otherwise
Digest output remains compatible with the existing multi-digest config structure
Integration tests cover the updated staged pipeline end-to-end
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
